name: Thai Tomato Coconut Soup with Grilled Chicken & Mixed Greens Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Peel and small dice the onion. Peel and mince the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onion
3 cloves garlic
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Melt coconut oil in the pot. Add the onion, garlic, and ginger. Cook, stirring frequently, until the onion is softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add the broth, diced tomatoes, coconut milk, salt, and pepper; stir to combine. Simmer for 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1062 ml (4 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
1 ½ (398 ml) can coconut milk
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Heat a grill, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium heat.
Cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.681 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat the grill or skillet with oil. Add the chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
Wash and dry the mixed greens.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, prepare the salad dressing by whisking together lime juice, olive oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
juice of ¾ lime
4 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp Dijon mustard
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut remaining lime into wedges for garnishing.
Using an immersion (hand) blender (or regular blender), purée the soup until smooth.
Slice the chicken crosswise on an angle.
Serve soup in a bowl and garnish with lime wedges. Arrange a bed of mixed greens on the side, top with chicken slices, and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!
